label: Предмет
description: A 10-sentence usage card for предмет (object; subject).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Предмет' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Этот' and 'тяжёлый' are agreeing masculine forms, and 'очень' intensifies the description.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Предмет' is the accusative direct object of 'нашёл', identical to the nominative for this inanimate noun. 'Странный' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Предмета' is the genitive marking whose name is meant. 'Названия' is a further genitive, and 'не помню' is the verb.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Предмету' is the dative governed by 'посвятил', here meaning a school subject. 'Этому' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Предмете' is the prepositional form after 'о', the topic of discussion. 'Школьном' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Предметом' is the instrumental governed by 'пользуется', marking the tool used. 'Острым' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Предмет' is the nominative predicate noun naming the favourite subject. 'Мой любимый' agrees in the masculine nominative.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Предметов' is the genitive plural after 'несколько'. 'На столе' gives the location, and 'лежит' is the verb.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Предметы' is the nominative plural subject of 'лежат'. 'Все' agrees in the plural, and 'на полке' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Предмета' is the genitive after 'без', marking absence. 'Нужного' agrees in the masculine genitive.
